name: Little bitch in heat
source:
A short little erotical novel with a cute little dog girl who is in heat for the first time. Luckily there is a male around taking care of her problem.

[From [url=https://little-huntress-team.itch.io/little-bitch-in-heat]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部简短的情色小小说，讲述了一个第一次发情的可爱小狗女孩。幸运的是，有一个男人在身边照顾她的问题。

[来自[url=https://little-huntress-team.itch.io/little-bitch-in-heat]Itch.io[/url]]
